segments.name: Human Nutrition and Health
segments.evidence: The Human Nutrition and Health ("HNH") segment provides human grade choline nutrients and mineral amino acid chelated products for nutrition and health applications.

segments.name: Animal Nutrition and Health
segments.description: Manufactures nutritional products for ruminant, monogastric, and companion animals using microencapsulation and chelation technologies.
segments.evidence: The Company's Animal Nutrition and Health ("ANH") segment provides nutritional products derived from its microencapsulation and chelation technologies in addition to the essential nutrient choline chloride.

segments.name: Specialty Products
segments.description: Re-packages and distributes performance gases and chemicals for sterilization, fumigation, and industrial uses, plus plant nutrition products.
segments.evidence: The Company's Specialty Products ("SP") segment re-packages and distributes a number of performance gases and chemicals for various uses by its customers, notably ethylene oxide, propylene oxide, and ammonia.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for specialty performance ingredients and products sold through the company's sales force, independent distributors, and sales agents.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our products through our own sales force, independent distributors and sales agents.

changes.text: In 2025, the European Commission announced provisional anti-dumping duties on choline chloride imports from China, with final duties set in December 2025.
changes.evidence: In late June 2025, the European Commission announced that it would impose provisional duties between 95.4% and 120.8% on imports into the European Union of choline chloride originating in the People's Republic of China, effective July 1, 2025.
